rules.R1: Every variant declared before running; none added or dropped post-hoc; report all including failures.
rules.R2: Rules derived strictly from STIX ontology relationships (malware -> uses -> attack-pattern) and prompt instruction boilerplate.
rules.R4: Neutral scientific tone: zero causal words.
rules.R5: Full reporting of all variants and full 4-budget scaling curves.

Vrel_T.description: Technique co-occurrence expansion via STIX uses relationships from detected malware entities to candidate techniques
Vrel_T.preprocessing: body-only queries via split_query; HD domain routing for cti-ate (enterprise vs mobile)
Vrel_T.entity_filter: malware entity type only, len >= 5 chars, case-sensitive exact match, OS stoplist exclusion
Vrel_T.relationship: STIX uses relationships: malware -> uses -> attack-pattern (non-revoked, within routed domain)
Vrel_T.scoring_formula: score(t) = sum_{s in detected_software} 1 / |{t' in techniques : s uses t'}|
Vrel_T.expansion: prepend canonical names and MITRE IDs of top 5 techniques (capped at 64 tokens)

E_comb_taa.description: Query hygiene (body-only) + Vrel relationship expansion on cti-taa

E_comb_ate.description: Query hygiene (body-only) + HD domain routing + Vrel-T technique expansion on cti-ate

statistical_testing.binary_sign_test: Exact two-sided binomial test (scipy.stats.binomtest with p=0.5 on discordant pairs)
statistical_testing.multiplicity: Holm step-down across declared P6 contrasts at family-wise alpha = 0.05
